summary: The change passes. athena.toml now turns job planning on with the caps from the design (0.75 USD each for planner and critic, 600 s timeouts, at most 3 rounds), and a new test checks that the file parses with those values. Tests that need planning off now strip the section wherever it sits in the file, so no test ends up with it twice. Only test code changed under crates/. New entry D110 in docs/decisions.md gives the six alternatives from section 7 of the design, the keep rule from section 9 (64% baseline, 30-job hold, at 100 jobs a 72% target with a 2.50 USD cost ceiling) and how to undo it (set enabled = false). CHANGELOG.md and the design's 'Built as' note record every edit. I ran cargo test --locked (every suite reported 0 failed), clippy with -D warnings and fmt --check, and all passed; these results come from this snapshot. Every changed file is on the deliverables list.
